name: Screen Studio
tagline: Capture screenshots (region/window/full), annotate, and record your screen to MP4/GIF — offline.
description: Capture the full screen, a chosen window, or a dragged region; annotate captures with arrows, boxes, text and highlights; and record your screen (with a region selector and adjustable FPS) to MP4 or animated GIF using a bundled FFmpeg. Copy to clipboard or save. Everything is local.
